headline: DYSPROSIUM IN DRILL — NIOB SEIGNEURIE RETURNS FIRST HEAVY RARE EARTH ASSAYS FROM QUÉBEC PEGMATITE DISTRICT (CSE:NIOB)
source_name: GlobeNewswire / North American Niobium & Critical Minerals Corp. (CSE:NIOB)
snippet: North American Niobium & Critical Minerals Corp. (CSE:NIOB) reported July 4, 2026 that initial laboratory results from the Seigneurie Project in Québec's Grenville Province confirmed heavy rare earth element mineralization in its first drillhole assays — including 10 metres averaging 76.7 ppm dysprosium oxide (Dy₂O₃) and a near-surface composite of 32.2 metres returning 528 ppm total heavy rare earth oxide (HREO), predominantly yttrium with dysprosium enrichment, within an approximately 105-metre interval of K-feldspar pegmatite. CEO Murray Nye noted that while grades are early-stage, the confirmed dysprosium-bearing pegmatite 'paired with a higher-grade intercept in the vicinity could change the perspective of the whole property.' Dysprosium and terbium are the most geopolitically restricted rare earth elements — used exclusively in high-performance NdFeB permanent magnets for EVs, wind turbines, and defence systems — with China's export licensing approval rates for dysprosium compounds falling below 15% for some Western industrial buyers in Q2 2026. An automated mineralogy study is in progress to identify mineral hosts and deportment; additional holes are planned in the 2026 program at this $2.69 million fully funded Quebec exploration campaign.

headline: LEVIATHAN-SCALE ANOMALY AT HOOK — HERCULES METALS DEFINES 1.7km SHALLOW PORPHYRY COPPER TARGET IN IDAHO (TSXV:BIG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Hercules Metals Corp. (TSXV:BIG)
snippet: Hercules Metals Corp. (TSXV:BIG) completed seven induced polarization geophysical survey lines at the Hook target on the Hercules Property in western Idaho, defining a large, continuous chargeability anomaly covering 1.7 kilometres of prospective strike length with values up to 40 mV/V starting near surface — a scale, geometry, and intensity directly comparable to the IP signature that led to the company's Leviathan porphyry copper discovery. Hook was initially identified in 2024 via anomalous molybdenum-bearing quartz veins; 2025 prospecting exposed subcrop with porphyry-style alteration, and the completed 28 line-kilometre IP survey now confirms a drill-ready target with a shallow NE-plunging geometry. Drilling at Hook is planned after inaugural holes at the adjacent Pegasus target, meaning Hercules has defined at minimum two new large IP-scale porphyry targets on top of the existing Leviathan system — which has previously returned intercepts of 788 metres at 0.54% CuEq and 802 metres at 0.40% CuEq. With COMEX copper near $6.20/lb and U.S. domestic copper projects commanding strategic premiums under the Section 232 tariff review, the expanding Hercules Idaho porphyry district is one of the highest-upside copper exploration stories currently active in North America.

headline: 6 RIGS AND 17.2M oz — FREEGOLD VENTURES DRILLS 2.08 g/t AU OVER 62m IN ALASKA INFILL AS PFS ACCELERATES (TSX:FVL)
source_name: Investing News Network / Freegold Ventures Ltd. (TSX:FVL)
snippet: Freegold Ventures Ltd. (TSX:FVL) reported July 2, 2026 additional infill drill results from its Golden Summit Project in Alaska's Fairbanks District, with hole GS2607 intersecting 102.3 metres of 1.67 g/t gold including a high-grade core of 62.1 metres at 2.08 g/t gold — with further high-grade intervals of 1.4 metres at 16.72 g/t gold and 2.6 metres at 10.16 g/t gold within the envelope. With six drill rigs now operating simultaneously and over 25,000 metres completed in the 2026 program, Freegold is advancing Golden Summit — one of the world's largest undeveloped open-pit-style gold deposits, hosting 17.2 million Indicated ounces at 1.24 g/t gold plus 11.9 million Inferred ounces — toward an updated Mineral Resource Estimate and Pre-Feasibility Study targeted for 2027. The infill focus on high-grade zones is specifically designed to define a starter-pit extraction sequence to anchor early project economics; results consistently demonstrate that the bulk-tonnage resource contains economically significant higher-grade zones that can materially improve NPV in a phased mining scenario.

headline: MINNESOTA DNR CLEARS PATH TO DRILL — 280Mt COPPER-NICKEL AT SERPENTINE, PHASE 1 STARTS AUGUST (CVE:GRBM)
snippet: Green Bridge Metals Corp. (CVE:GRBM) announced July 2, 2026 that the Minnesota Department of Natural Resources approved its exploration drilling plan for the Serpentine Copper-Nickel Project in St. Louis County, unlocking Phase 1 diamond core drilling scheduled to commence August 2026 via Foraco International (a minimum 1,640-metre initial program). Serpentine hosts an Inferred Mineral Resource of 279.9 million tonnes at 0.37% copper, 0.12% nickel, and 0.007% cobalt — including 21.6 million tonnes Indicated at 0.46% Cu, 0.16% Ni — making it one of the largest undeveloped copper-nickel deposits in the continental United States. Parallel metallurgical test work will assess processing characteristics and recovery pathways to advance toward scoping-level studies. The DNR approval is a meaningful regulatory milestone in a jurisdiction historically cautious toward new hard-rock mining; domestic copper-nickel remains a priority under the Trump administration's critical minerals strategy, and Serpentine's scale positions it as a rare large-tonnage option in North America at a time when new copper mines are needed to close the structural deficit amplified by the U.S. tariff review.

headline: BC INAUGURAL DRILL LOCKED IN — GOLDHAVEN ENGAGES NORTHTECH FOR 5-7,000m AT TUNGSTEN-SILVER-GOLD MAGNO PROJECT (CSE:GOH)
snippet: GoldHaven Resources Corp. (CSE:GOH) announced July 2, 2026 a drilling services agreement with Northtech Drilling Ltd. to conduct an inaugural 5,000–7,000 metre diamond core program at the 100%-owned Magno Project in northern BC's Cassiar District, with mobilization planned approximately August 1, 2026 subject to permitting. Magno hosts historical high-grade tungsten and silver mineralization discovered in the 1960s–1980s; a recently completed 2,320-line-kilometre airborne QMAGT geophysical survey generated the priority drill targets for the inaugural program. Tungsten is among the most geopolitically restricted critical minerals of 2026, appearing in Category 1 of China's export licensing controls, with European and North American aerospace, defence, and semiconductor sectors unable to adequately source supply from non-Chinese primary producers — conditions that give Canadian tungsten-bearing exploration projects exceptional strategic relevance for the first time in decades. The Cassiar District of northern BC hosts the historic Cantung Mine, historically Canada's primary tungsten producer, making the district geologically validated for economically significant scheelite mineralization.

headline: 5,212 LINE-KM ATHABASCA SURVEY COMPLETE — TRACTION URANIUM ADVANCES TO DRILL TARGET GENERATION AT AURORA (TSXV:TUC)
snippet: Traction Uranium Corp. (TSXV:TUC) announced July 2, 2026 the successful completion of a high-resolution airborne radiometric and aeromagnetic survey covering 5,212 line-kilometres at 50-metre line spacing across the Aurora Uranium Project in the southeastern Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan. The survey crew has demobilized and data is now undergoing quality assurance processing and interpretation to identify radiometric anomalies consistent with near-surface uranium mineralization, with target generation and follow-up exploration updates to follow. Aurora covers approximately 17 kilometres of prospective strike along the southeastern Basin margin — a corridor that hosts the Millennium deposit — and Traction holds an option to earn an 80% interest in the project from Cosa Resources Corp. by solely financing $9.15 million in exploration expenditures. The announcement confirms Traction's 2026 field season is fully operational, running concurrently with renewed utility contracting interest as uranium spot prices stabilize following Q2 softness from the $101/lb January 2026 peak; the Athabasca Basin is the world's highest-grade uranium district and the centre of gravity for institutional uranium exploration capital.

headline: FIVE TARGETS IN PATTERSON LAKE CORRIDOR — BLAST RESOURCES PLOTS FIRST DRILL HOLES AT WALES LAKE NEAR NEXGEN ARROW DEPOSIT
snippet: Blast Resources Inc. announced July 3, 2026 that a high-resolution airborne magnetic survey over three claim groups at the Wales Lake Project in the southwestern Athabasca Basin has identified five priority targets — defined by magnetic lineaments and regional uranium-thorium anomalies — providing clear direction for the company's first drill program. Wales Lake is located within the Patterson Lake Corridor, the same structural trend that hosts NexGen Energy's Arrow deposit, widely regarded as the world's highest-grade undeveloped uranium deposit, and Fission Uranium's Triple R (2.2 million tonnes at 1.58% U₃O₈). The southwest Athabasca Basin corridor is the most technically active uranium exploration district in Saskatchewan in 2026, with multiple companies simultaneously advancing first-principles target generation work as the high-grade unconformity-style discovery premium commands significant exploration capital from uranium-focused investors watching the sector's structural supply deficit widen into the early 2030s.

headline: WORLD GOLD COUNCIL 'POINT BREAK': GOLD RANGEBOUND AT $4,100 BUT CLEAR UPSIDE IF RATES OR GEOPOLITICS SHIFT IN H2
snippet: The World Gold Council published its Gold Mid-Year Outlook 2026, titled 'Point Break,' on July 1, concluding that gold is likely to remain rangebound near US$4,100/oz under the current macro consensus — which assumes at least one Fed rate hike by October, parallel central bank tightening in the UK, Japan, and Europe, and U.S. inflation peaking near 3.9% in Q2 — but retains 'clear upside potential if risks intensify or policy expectations shift.' The report's most notable structural finding is that Asian markets are now the primary driver of gold price recoveries, with price declines concentrated in U.S. trading hours while Asian trading hours provide the buying floor — a regime shift from the Western-dominated price discovery of prior cycles that explains why retail Western investors have felt systematically wrong-footed. The WGC identifies three upside catalysts that could push gold above US$4,500/oz: global economic deceleration, geopolitical escalation, or a meaningful shift in Federal Reserve rate expectations — all of which became materially more probable after the June payrolls miss (57,000 vs. 110,000 consensus) and the subsequent collapse in September rate-hike probability to below 50%. For junior mining investors, the WGC's endorsement of current gold levels as fundamentally supported — rather than technically broken — is a key signal for position-sizing decisions ahead of Q3.

headline: VOTE JULY 22 — EQUINOX GOLD-ORLA MINING $18.5B ALL-SHARE MERGER WOULD CREATE CANADA'S LARGEST GOLD PRODUCER (TSX:EQX/ORLA)
source_name: GlobeNewswire / Equinox Gold Corp. (TSX:EQX) & Orla Mining Ltd. (TSX:ORLA)
snippet: Equinox Gold Corp. (TSX:EQX) and Orla Mining Ltd. (TSX:ORLA) proceed to a shareholder vote on July 22, 2026 on the proposed all-share business combination that would create an $18.5 billion-combined-market-cap North American gold producer — the largest all-share gold consolidation in Canadian history by combined enterprise value. Under the deal, each Orla share is exchanged for 1.00 EQX share plus US$0.0001; Equinox will issue up to 421.8 million new shares, with Equinox shareholders retaining approximately 67% of the combined company. The merged entity is projected to produce over 1.1 million ounces of gold in 2026 from six operating mines across Canada, the U.S., Nicaragua, and Mexico, with approximately US$1.4 billion in free cash flow and liquidity. Both boards unanimously recommend a vote FOR the arrangement; the proxy deadline is July 20 at 9:00 a.m. Vancouver time, with court and remaining regulatory approvals expected ahead of an anticipated Q3 2026 close. Institutional support includes backing from Pierre Lassonde. At gold near $4,174/oz, the combined company would rank among the top 10 gold producers globally by market capitalization and is explicitly positioned as a growth-through-portfolio vehicle versus a pure-play consolidation.
